versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the open-arxiv skill.
- Opens the arXiv homepage in the user's Brave browser.
- Focuses an existing Brave window and reuses an open arXiv tab if available.
- Ensures only a single arXiv tab is opened and loaded.
- Verifies the correct website is open before confirming success.
- Uses the user's existing authenticated browser session without handling logins.
